question: Show Non-Small Cell Lung PD-L1, CTLA-4 trials conducted in 2018 or later.

gemini.answer: This SQL query selects the NCT ID, author, year, cancer type, and ICI class for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) trials conducted in 2018 or later that used PD-L1 or CTLA-4 inhibitors.
gemini.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"cancer_type\", \"ici_class\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" = 'NSCLC' AND \"year\" >= 2018 AND \"ici_class\" IN ('PD-L1', 'CTLA-4');","answer":"This SQL query selects the NCT ID, author, year, cancer type, and ICI class for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) trials conducted in 2018 or later that used PD-L1 or CTLA-4 inhibitors.","assumptions":""}
